description: A heavyset older man with a bald crown sits in an ornate gold-brocade robe with a jeweled brooch, in a dark room lit by two tall candles. A young man in a grey robe kneels at his feet, and a few men in red cardinal robes stand or sit behind them. A chest of gold coins sits to the right beside a young attendant in red who holds the gold train. The setting is a dark palace interior with heavy drapes and a stone arch. I see no visible text, no frame, and no blood or nudity.
